prompt: State one familiar everyday benchmark that can serve as a reference for a length of approximately $1\text{ metre}$.
answer: The distance from the floor to a standard door handle (or the length of a guitar / waist height of an adult human / long stride).

mark_scheme.criterion: States any valid everyday 1-metre benchmark (e.g. floor to door handle / waist height of an adult / length of a guitar / stride length).

hints: Where does a 1-metre mark reach on an adult body or door?
solution: A common everyday benchmark for approximately 1 metre is the height of a door handle above the floor (or the waist height of an adult).
teacher_walkthrough: Accept any realistic physical object that is approximately 1 m long.
Demonstrates grounding in concrete physical reality.

provenance.independence_statement: Authored as an original drill on length benchmarks.
